name: Signet Plastics
old_description: Precision plastic manufacturing with over 30 years of experience
about:
Signet Plastics was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Maryville, Tennessee. The company describes itself as a leading processor of plastics with over 30 years of industry experience, though it does not disclose its founders or ownership structure publicly.

Signet Plastics provides custom plastic injection molding services for manufacturers requiring precision, consistency, and dependable delivery. Its capabilities include overmolding, hot stamping, pad printing, tooling and part design, as well as assembly and secondary operations, all backed by quality and process control programs. The company has not published details on facility size, employee count, or annual production volumes.

The company serves a diverse client base across automotive, medical, consumer, and industrial applications, producing high-quality molded plastic components tailored to each sector's requirements.

Signet Plastics emphasizes that its reputation is built on service excellence and a commitment to providing the highest quality, with a goal not just to meet but to exceed customer expectations. It positions itself as a partner in its customers' success rather than merely a plastics processor.
